params.message:
Preview links for drafts, and images copied from a piece's sources

Images from the sources. POST /articles/:id/images/from-source {url}: only an image the piece's cited
signals carry (the list the cover picker offers), fetched from the public web
only (assertPublic, redirects checked one by one), an image type only, at most
8 MB. The copy lands in store/uploads like any body image and in the piece's
image pool with article_images.credit (source name, signal, its page, the
image's own address); asked again it returns the same copy. The cover picker
offers the copy as one of the piece's own images instead of the original.

Preview links. POST /articles/:id/preview-link (anyone who may see the piece, posts only)
makes a random token, keeps only its SHA-256 with the piece and an expiry of 30
minutes (article_preview_links, core/site-preview.mjs), and answers the site's
/preview/<token> address. GET /internal/projection/preview/:token, behind
PROJECTION_TOKEN like every projection read, gives the site the piece in the
shape of a published article (projectedArticle, now shared with the article
read), 404 for an unknown link and 410 for one that ran out. The site has no
other way to a draft: the manifest it reconciles from still lists published
posts only.

PUBLIC_SITE_BASE sets the site's address (default https://gentells.com).
